summary: Grupo Cibest S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing that Nequi S.A. Compañía de Financiamiento, a subsidiary, is expected to begin operations as a new financial entity, independent from Bancolombia S.A., on September 1, 2026, after completion of asset, liability, and contract transfers. This operational reorganization within Grupo Cibest follows a November 6, 2025 regulatory authorization from Colombia's Financial Superintendency. No pricing, premium, or shareholder-level transaction terms are disclosed. Both entities remain part of Grupo Cibest; customer access is unchanged. This is a routine internal corporate structure announcement, not a special situation.
